about.helpTitle: Any questions? Find the answers here.

items.title: A fan community
items.body: A space to find products from your favorite artists and connect with those who sell them.

items.title: Support sellers
items.body: Discover stores and sellers who share your passion for K-Pop.

items.title: Buy directly from sellers
items.body: Connect and coordinate your purchase directly with the seller.

items.question: Do I need a payment gateway?
items.answer: No — buyers upload their proof of payment manually. Bank transfer, Wise, PayPal, whatever you already use.

items.question: Can I sell only photocards, not full group orders?
items.answer: Yes — Bias Market works for album group orders, individual photocard claims, set splits and fan-made merch drops.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Free for early sellers while we keep building the product.
